newsitem.title: POLAND: Espebepe tumbles 9.5 pct after gains.
newsitem.headline: Espebepe tumbles 9.5 pct after gains.

text.p: Polish construction firm Espebepe SA tumbled 9.5 percent to 5.7 zlotys, returning to large speculative swings based on whether the ailing builder will receive a debt restructuring deal, traders said.
Creditors of Espebepe, which is 75 million zlotys in debt, are due to meet on May 16.
The stock, for which selling was strong enough after price fixing to reduce players' bids, had risen since late March on positive speculation about the firm's fate.
The company plans a new issue to its creditors of 20 percent of current share capital at five zlotys per share if they agree to a debt write-off deal.
